newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's JSE suspends Shoredits shares.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's JSE suspends Shoredits shares.

text.p: The Johannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE) said on Thursday shares in Shoredits Ltd had been suspended with immediate effect pending clarity on talks relating to a proposed recapitalisation of the firm.

The JSE said that the shares would remain in the JSE Actuaries All Share and Small Capitalisation Indices for a period of five days. If after five days the suspension had not been lifted, the share would be removed from the indices.
Shoredits said earlier this week it had been put under provisional judicial management with effect from January 24.

The building and construction group had announced last week that it was seeking to recapitalise after Samrand Development Holdings Ltd terminated talks which would have led to Samrand acquiring a controlling interest in Shoredits.
The company's shares have fallen sharply from a high of 380 cents in January 1996. They closed on Thursday at 44 cents after reaching a low of 25 cents on January 22 this year.
